t: Authorizing Director of Public Works to execute the necessary documents to accept and expend $453,392, which includes indirect costs of $52,580 or seven percent of the total project budget of $723,000…
Accepting Deed to Land for Street Purposes.

Supervisor Halley, seconded by Supervisor Zirpoli, moved that Supervisor Tinney be excused from voting on all legislation relating to the granting of revocable permits to occupy the street or sidewalk area.
